title: UV era
note: UV era per docs/eras/uv.md ("Validator (-Tier uv)", "Gate to UHV"), in three substages: uv (home, Earth orbit and the Moon), uv-neptune (Neptune orbit) and uv-pluto (Pluto orbit, after Neptune: the penetrator's catalyst is the Triton ice core). Dimension ids come from tables/orbits.json and tables/places.json through the orbit and place tokens (gcyr:luna is GCYR's). ZPM's "nothing UV" checks are dropped; the Mk2 cuts become exceptRecipes plus mk3-recipes-only-mk3. The three generators are EU sources at their final figures (euPerTick). Each package's targets WARN until a dump carries it (packages).

machines.note: UV era: the Mk1 never starts a recipe above 160 M EU, nor the six the Mk3 keeps (tables/fusion_mk3.json mk3Only).
GTM's Mk2: 320 M EU to start (tables/fusion_mk2.json maxStart); with the condition raised to the Mk3's 640 M, the six Mk3-only recipes are cut by id.
Uranus orbit: the only source of diamond slurry; the Neptune rows of the same GTM type are the deep siphon's.

GTM's Mk3: 40 M EU per hatch, 640 M on 16 UV hatches (S0-4); the only machine that runs the six mk3Only recipes (neutronium, americium, naquadria, iron and nickel plasma, oganesson). Its UV hatches take the ZPM grid (a hatch accepts any lower voltage; the fusion reactor's recipe cap is its tier): the Mk3 comes before the gravi star, so before eu:uv.

UV era: GTM's UHV recipes (1,966,080 EU/t: the UHV energy hatch) on two UV hatches (GTM: two hatches of the highest tier count as the next tier).

Trinium-coil EBF on two ZPM hatches (UV voltage, 524,288 EU/t): the 491,520 EU/t rows. UEV-A6 added it for the orbit rows; the UV controllers take the fused silica tube since QR-R4, so it starts here.
UV era: GCYM's alloy blast smelter with a tritanium coil on two LuV hatches (ZPM voltage, 122,880 EU/t): RTAN for the UHV hatch's double wire (10,800 K).
The extraction cascade's pattern takes any 1-2 energy hatches (Pat.part('energy_input')): on two LuV hatches it runs its ZPM rows (c5 monazite froth, c6 ytterbium strip, 122,880 EU/t).

GTCA's COMET (the fusion reactor's layout in Comet outer casing around cyclotron coils; any outer casing can be a hatch or bus): hydrogen and a hydrogen ion into protons (S0-7) for the synchrotron's antiproton row.

synthetic.note: The Neptune trip (B1): the level 6 rocket ZPM already flies (aerogel tank, tier 9); UV adds no chart. The station kit is GCYR's packager (tables/stations.json more).
The Pluto trip (B1): the level 7 rocket, the BNNT tank (tier 11, the cryotank winder, the Pluto-Kuiper chart as catalyst) with an elite motor.
The network's UV tier (A9): UV only when every formed tower holds UV SMES cells, linked by the gravi star (tables/wireless_energy.json). wireless:uv is the gate's "network at UV".
